career_ladder.note: Governed by the Punjab Police Act, 2007 (Punjab Act No. 10 of 2008), the Punjab Police Rules, 1934 (as amended for Punjab), and Department of Home Affairs and Justice notifications. Promotion from Constable to Head Constable is regulated by passing the qualifying Lower School Course (List B-1 / B-I test) at the Police Training College (PTC), Phillaur or upon completion of prescribed qualifying length of unblemished service in the District or Armed Police Cadre.

exam_scheme.note: Selection process comprises three stages: Stage I (Computer Based Test comprising Paper I and mandatory qualifying Paper II Punjabi), Stage II (Physical Screening Test and Physical Measurement Test), and Stage III (Document Scrutiny). Final selection list is drawn strictly from marks scored in Paper I among candidates who qualify Paper II (Punjabi) and the PST/PMT physical standards.

stages.source_label: Punjab Police Recruitment Notification (Constable in District & Armed Cadres) — Scheme of Examination

papers.paper_name: Paper I (General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude, Mental Ability, English, Punjabi Language, Digital Literacy)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking (1 mark per correct answer)

papers.paper_name: Paper II (Mandatory Qualifying Punjabi Language Paper equivalent to Matriculation standard)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking (1 mark per correct answer)

stages.stage_name: Stage II: Physical Screening Test (PST) & Physical Measurement Test (PMT)
stages.source_label: Punjab Police Recruitment Notification — Physical Standards & Screening Norms

papers.paper_name: Physical Screening Test (Male: 1600m run in 6:30 min, Long Jump 3.80m, High Jump 1.10m; Female: 800m run in 4:30 min, Long Jump 3.00m, High Jump 0.95m)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying standard in all three physical events

papers.paper_name: Physical Measurement Test (Height verification: Male minimum 5 ft 7 in / 170.2 cm; Female minimum 5 ft 2 in / 157.5 cm)

stages.stage_name: Stage III: Document Scrutiny & Character Antecedent Verification
stages.source_label: Punjab Police Recruitment Notification — Document Scrutiny & Scrutiny Procedure

papers.paper_name: Scrutiny of original certificates (Matriculation Punjabi certificate, 10+2 marksheet, domicile, category credentials, biometric match)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Production of valid original certificates and verification

financial_package.note: Salaries for Constables in the Punjab Police are governed by the Punjab Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2021 notified by the Department of Finance, Government of Punjab. Newly appointed constables enter at Punjab Pay Matrix Level 2 with a minimum entry basic pay of ₹19,900. In accordance with Government of Punjab Department of Finance policy instructions (Letters No. 7/204/2012-4FP1/60 dated 15.01.2015 and No. 7/42/2020-5FP1/741-746 dated 17.07.2020), newly recruited personnel receive fixed minimum basic pay without allowances during their initial 3-year probation period, after which regular statutory allowances (DA, HRA, uniform allowance, ration allowance, medical) are drawn in full.
financial_package.pay_level: Punjab Pay Matrix Level 2 (Entry Basic ₹19,900; Scale ₹19,900 - ₹63,200)
financial_package.pay_source_label: Punjab Police Advt. No. 01/2024 & Punjab Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules 2021, Department of Finance, Government of Punjab
financial_package.estimate_note: Post-probation gross salary is computed from Punjab Pay Matrix Level 2 basic ₹19,900 + 58% DA (₹11,542) + Punjab HRA (ranging from 8% in rural police stations to 16% in major cities like SAS Nagar/Mohali, Ludhiana, Amritsar, Jalandhar: ₹1,592 to ₹3,184) + fixed medical allowance (₹1,000) + special police ration and conveyance allowances. Net in-hand estimate reflects statutory deductions including 10% NPS contribution (Basic + DA = ₹3,144), Punjab Development Tax (₹200/month), and GIS (₹120). Appointees draw fixed basic ₹19,900 during initial probation as per state policy.
official_perks: Government police barracks / family accommodation in police lines or district quarters (subject to availability)
Uniform and kit maintenance allowance sanctioned under Punjab Police Rules
Free medical treatment and reimbursement for self and dependent family members under Punjab Government Medical Attendance Rules
Contributory pension coverage under the National Pension System (NPS) with 14% Government of Punjab employer contribution
Special Police Welfare Fund benefits, ex-gratia compensation, and Group Insurance Scheme (GIS) cover
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and 30 days annual earned leave entitlement plus casual leave
